variables.name: Servicio
Canal

0.content:
## Nexus V2
Las secciones 1 a 4 leen las métricas de ingesta (`custom.nexus.log.*`): cuestan lo mismo con cualquier rango, pero solo tienen datos desde que se creó cada una; `soap_responses` todavía no existe, así que las tiles B / M / C y la alerta 5 salen vacías. Las secciones 5 y 6 leen logs: conviene un rango corto, sobre todo para la traza por rquid. La 7 mira siempre los últimos 15 minutos. Cluster: uno, varios o `*`. Servicio y Canal filtran respuestas, errores de mapeo, timeouts y errores del mngr; las alertas solo se filtran por Cluster.

1.title: Respuestas adaptador
1.query:
timeseries r = sum(custom.nexus.log.adapter.responses), by: { cluster, service, channel, outcome }
| filter (in("*", $Cluster) or in(cluster, $Cluster)) and ($Servicio == "*" or service == $Servicio) and (in("*", $Canal) or in(channel, $Canal))
| fieldsAdd n = arraySum(r)
| summarize responses = sum(n)

2.title: % OK (2xx)
2.query:
timeseries r = sum(custom.nexus.log.adapter.responses), by: { cluster, service, channel, outcome }
| filter (in("*", $Cluster) or in(cluster, $Cluster)) and ($Servicio == "*" or service == $Servicio) and (in("*", $Canal) or in(channel, $Canal))
| fieldsAdd n = arraySum(r)
| summarize total = sum(n), x = sum(if(outcome == "ok_2xx", n, else: 0))
| fields pct_ok = round(100.0 * x / total, decimals: 2)

3.title: % 412 (negocio)
3.query:
timeseries r = sum(custom.nexus.log.adapter.responses), by: { cluster, service, channel, outcome }
| filter (in("*", $Cluster) or in(cluster, $Cluster)) and ($Servicio == "*" or service == $Servicio) and (in("*", $Canal) or in(channel, $Canal))
| fieldsAdd n = arraySum(r)
| summarize total = sum(n), x = sum(if(outcome == "business_412", n, else: 0))
| fields pct_412 = round(100.0 * x / total, decimals: 2)

4.title: % error
4.query:
timeseries r = sum(custom.nexus.log.adapter.responses), by: { cluster, service, channel, outcome }
| filter (in("*", $Cluster) or in(cluster, $Cluster)) and ($Servicio == "*" or service == $Servicio) and (in("*", $Canal) or in(channel, $Canal))
| fieldsAdd n = arraySum(r)
| summarize total = sum(n), x = sum(if(outcome == "error", n, else: 0))
| fields pct_error = round(100.0 * x / total, decimals: 2)

5.title: Timeouts 504
5.query:
timeseries t = sum(custom.nexus.log.adapter.timeouts), by: { cluster, service, channel }
| filter (in("*", $Cluster) or in(cluster, $Cluster)) and ($Servicio == "*" or service == $Servicio) and (in("*", $Canal) or in(channel, $Canal))
| fieldsAdd n = arraySum(t)
| summarize timeouts = sum(n)

6.title: % rechazo al canal (M)
6.query:
timeseries s = sum(custom.nexus.log.mngr.soap_responses), by: { cluster, acceptance, soap.operation, soap.msg_code }
| filter (in("*", $Cluster) or in(cluster, $Cluster))
| fieldsAdd n = arraySum(s)
| summarize total = sum(n), m = sum(if(acceptance == "M", n, else: 0))
| fields pct_m = round(100.0 * m / total, decimals: 2)

8.title: ALERTAS DE UMBRAL FIJO: MINUTOS SOBRE EL UMBRAL
8.query:
timeseries total = sum(custom.nexus.log.adapter.responses, default: 0), by: { cluster }, interval: 1m
| join [
    timeseries errors = sum(custom.nexus.log.adapter.responses, default: 0), by: { cluster },
        filter: outcome == "error", interval: 1m
  ], on: { cluster }, fields: { errors }
| fieldsAdd error_pct = if(total[] > 10, 100.0 * errors[] / total[], else: 0.0)
| fieldsKeep timeframe, interval, cluster, error_pct
| fieldsAdd above = if(error_pct[] > 5, 1, else: 0)
| fieldsAdd win5 = arrayMovingSum(above, 5)
| fieldsAdd firing = if(win5[] >= 3, 1, else: 0)
| fields alert = "1. % error real del adaptador (umbral 5%)", cluster,
    max_value = arrayMax(error_pct), minutes_above = arraySum(above), minutes_firing = arraySum(firing)
| append [
    timeseries timeouts = sum(custom.nexus.log.adapter.timeouts, default: 0), by: { cluster }, interval: 1m
    | fieldsAdd above = if(timeouts[] > 2, 1, else: 0)
    | fieldsAdd win5 = arrayMovingSum(above, 5)
    | fieldsAdd firing = if(win5[] >= 3, 1, else: 0)
    | fields alert = "2. Timeouts 504 (umbral 2 por minuto)", cluster,
        max_value = arrayMax(timeouts), minutes_above = arraySum(above), minutes_firing = arraySum(firing)
  ]
| append [
    timeseries mapping_errors = sum(custom.nexus.log.adapter.mapping_errors, default: 0), by: { cluster }, interval: 1m
    | fieldsAdd above = if(mapping_errors[] > 2, 1, else: 0)
    | fieldsAdd win5 = arrayMovingSum(above, 5)
    | fieldsAdd firing = if(win5[] >= 3, 1, else: 0)
    | fields alert = "3. Errores de mapeo (umbral 2 por minuto)", cluster,
        max_value = arrayMax(mapping_errors), minutes_above = arraySum(above), minutes_firing = arraySum(firing)
  ]
| append [
    timeseries backend_5xx = sum(custom.nexus.log.adapter.responses, default: 0), by: { cluster },
        filter: startsWith(http_code, "5"), interval: 1m
    | fieldsAdd above = if(backend_5xx[] > 1, 1, else: 0)
    | fieldsAdd win5 = arrayMovingSum(above, 5)
    | fieldsAdd firing = if(win5[] >= 3, 1, else: 0)
    | fields alert = "4. 5xx del backend (umbral 1 por minuto)", cluster,
        max_value = arrayMax(backend_5xx), minutes_above = arraySum(above), minutes_firing = arraySum(firing)
  ]
| append [
    timeseries total = sum(custom.nexus.log.mngr.soap_responses, default: 0), by: { cluster }, interval: 1m
    | join [
        timeseries rejected = sum(custom.nexus.log.mngr.soap_responses, default: 0), by: { cluster },
            filter: acceptance == "M", interval: 1m
      ], on: { cluster }, fields: { rejected }
    | fieldsAdd rejection_pct = if(total[] > 10, 100.0 * rejected[] / total[], else: 0.0)
    | fieldsKeep timeframe, interval, cluster, rejection_pct
    | fieldsAdd above = if(rejection_pct[] > 40, 1, else: 0)
    | fieldsAdd win5 = arrayMovingSum(above, 5)
    | fieldsAdd firing = if(win5[] >= 3, 1, else: 0)
    | fields alert = "5. % respuestas M al canal (umbral 40%)", cluster,
        max_value = arrayMax(rejection_pct), minutes_above = arraySum(above), minutes_firing = arraySum(firing)
  ]
| append [
    timeseries total = sum(custom.nexus.log.adapter.backend_calls, default: 0), by: { cluster }, interval: 1m
    | join [
        timeseries slow = sum(custom.nexus.log.adapter.backend_calls, default: 0), by: { cluster },
            filter: in(latency_bucket, array("1-5s", "5s+")), interval: 1m
      ], on: { cluster }, fields: { slow }
    | fieldsAdd slow_pct = if(total[] > 10, 100.0 * slow[] / total[], else: 0.0)
    | fieldsKeep timeframe, interval, cluster, slow_pct
    | fieldsAdd above = if(slow_pct[] > 5, 1, else: 0)
    | fieldsAdd win5 = arrayMovingSum(above, 5)
    | fieldsAdd firing = if(win5[] >= 3, 1, else: 0)
    | fields alert = "7. % llamadas al backend de más de 1 s (umbral 5%)", cluster,
        max_value = arrayMax(slow_pct), minutes_above = arraySum(above), minutes_firing = arraySum(firing)
  ]
| filter (in("*", $Cluster) or in(cluster, $Cluster)) and minutes_above > 0
| sort minutes_firing desc, minutes_above desc
8.description: minutes_firing = minutos en que se cumplía 3 de 5 (aproximación, sin dealerting). Sin filas: ningún cluster pasó un umbral en el rango

9.title: 1. % ERROR REAL DEL ADAPTADOR
9.query:
timeseries total = sum(custom.nexus.log.adapter.responses, default: 0), by: { cluster }, interval: 1m
| join [
    timeseries errors = sum(custom.nexus.log.adapter.responses, default: 0), by: { cluster },
        filter: outcome == "error", interval: 1m
  ], on: { cluster }, fields: { errors }
| fieldsAdd error_pct = if(total[] > 10, 100.0 * errors[] / total[], else: 0.0)
| fieldsKeep timeframe, interval, cluster, error_pct
| filter (in("*", $Cluster) or in(cluster, $Cluster))

10.title: 2. TIMEOUTS 504
10.query:
timeseries timeouts = sum(custom.nexus.log.adapter.timeouts, default: 0), by: { cluster }, interval: 1m
| filter (in("*", $Cluster) or in(cluster, $Cluster))
10.description: Umbral fijo: 2 por minuto, 3 de 5 minutos

11.title: 3. ERRORES DE MAPEO
11.query:
timeseries mapping_errors = sum(custom.nexus.log.adapter.mapping_errors, default: 0), by: { cluster }, interval: 1m
| filter (in("*", $Cluster) or in(cluster, $Cluster))
11.description: Umbral fijo: 2 por minuto, 3 de 5 minutos

12.title: 4. 5XX DEL BACKEND
12.query:
timeseries backend_5xx = sum(custom.nexus.log.adapter.responses, default: 0), by: { cluster },
    filter: startsWith(http_code, "5"), interval: 1m
| filter (in("*", $Cluster) or in(cluster, $Cluster))
12.description: Umbral fijo: 1 por minuto, 3 de 5 minutos

13.title: 5. % RESPUESTAS M AL CANAL
13.query:
timeseries total = sum(custom.nexus.log.mngr.soap_responses, default: 0), by: { cluster }, interval: 1m
| join [
    timeseries rejected = sum(custom.nexus.log.mngr.soap_responses, default: 0), by: { cluster },
        filter: acceptance == "M", interval: 1m
  ], on: { cluster }, fields: { rejected }
| fieldsAdd rejection_pct = if(total[] > 10, 100.0 * rejected[] / total[], else: 0.0)
| fieldsKeep timeframe, interval, cluster, rejection_pct
| filter (in("*", $Cluster) or in(cluster, $Cluster))
13.description: Umbral fijo: 40%, 3 de 5 minutos. Sin datos hasta crear la métrica soap_responses

14.title: 6. ERRORES DEL MNGR
14.query:
timeseries mngr_errors = sum(custom.nexus.log.mngr.errors, default: 0), by: { cluster }, interval: 1m
| filter (in("*", $Cluster) or in(cluster, $Cluster))

15.title: 7. % LLAMADAS AL BACKEND DE MÁS DE 1 S
15.query:
timeseries total = sum(custom.nexus.log.adapter.backend_calls, default: 0), by: { cluster }, interval: 1m
| join [
    timeseries slow = sum(custom.nexus.log.adapter.backend_calls, default: 0), by: { cluster },
        filter: in(latency_bucket, array("1-5s", "5s+")), interval: 1m
  ], on: { cluster }, fields: { slow }
| fieldsAdd slow_pct = if(total[] > 10, 100.0 * slow[] / total[], else: 0.0)
| fieldsKeep timeframe, interval, cluster, slow_pct
| filter (in("*", $Cluster) or in(cluster, $Cluster))

16.title: 8. RESPUESTAS TARDÍAS DE STRATUS
16.query:
timeseries late_replies = sum(custom.nexus.log.adapter.stratus_late_replies, default: 0), by: { cluster }, interval: 1m
| filter (in("*", $Cluster) or in(cluster, $Cluster))

17.title: 9. CONSUMIDOR QUE NO COINCIDE, POR CADA 100 TRANSACCIONES
17.query:
timeseries tx = sum(custom.nexus.log.adapter.responses, default: 0), by: { cluster }, interval: 5m
| join [
    timeseries mismatches = sum(custom.nexus.log.mngr.consumer_mismatch, default: 0), by: { cluster }, interval: 5m
  ], on: { cluster }, fields: { mismatches }
| fieldsAdd per_100_tx = if(tx[] > 50, 100.0 * mismatches[] / tx[], else: 0.0)
| fieldsKeep timeframe, interval, cluster, per_100_tx
| filter (in("*", $Cluster) or in(cluster, $Cluster))

18.title: 10. DATOS INCOMPLETOS DEL BACKEND
18.query:
timeseries stream_issues = sum(custom.nexus.log.adapter.stream_issues, default: 0), by: { cluster }, interval: 5m
| filter (in("*", $Cluster) or in(cluster, $Cluster))

19.title: 11. CAÍDA DE TRÁFICO
19.query:
timeseries responses = sum(custom.nexus.log.adapter.responses, default: 0), by: { cluster }, interval: 5m
| filter (in("*", $Cluster) or in(cluster, $Cluster))

21.title: RESPUESTAS ADAPTADOR EN EL TIEMPO
21.description: ok_2xx y business_412 no son error

22.title: ERRORES ADAPTADOR POR CLUSTER

23.title: % ERROR POR CLUSTER
23.query:
timeseries r = sum(custom.nexus.log.adapter.responses), by: { cluster, service, channel, outcome }
| filter (in("*", $Cluster) or in(cluster, $Cluster)) and ($Servicio == "*" or service == $Servicio) and (in("*", $Canal) or in(channel, $Canal))
| fieldsAdd n = arraySum(r)
| summarize total = sum(n), errors = sum(if(outcome == "error", n, else: 0)),
    business_412 = sum(if(outcome == "business_412", n, else: 0)),
    unknown = sum(if(outcome == "unknown", n, else: 0)), by: { cluster }
| fieldsAdd pct_error = round(100.0 * errors / total, decimals: 2)
| sort pct_error desc

24.title: RESPUESTAS POR SERVICIO Y CANAL
24.query:
timeseries r = sum(custom.nexus.log.adapter.responses), by: { cluster, service, channel, outcome }
| filter (in("*", $Cluster) or in(cluster, $Cluster)) and ($Servicio == "*" or service == $Servicio) and (in("*", $Canal) or in(channel, $Canal))
| fieldsAdd n = arraySum(r)
| summarize total = sum(n), errors = sum(if(outcome == "error", n, else: 0)),
    business_412 = sum(if(outcome == "business_412", n, else: 0)),
    by: { cluster, service, channel }
| fieldsAdd pct_error = round(100.0 * errors / total, decimals: 2)
| sort errors desc, total desc
| limit 50

25.title: RESPUESTAS POR CÓDIGO HTTP

26.title: ERRORES DE MAPEO POR SERVICIO Y CAMPO

27.title: TIMEOUTS 504 POR CLUSTER

28.title: TIMEOUTS 504 POR SERVICIO Y CANAL

29.title: RESPUESTAS TARDÍAS DE STRATUS
29.description: Stratus contestó después de que el adaptador cortó. Un 504 sin respuesta tardía = Stratus no contestó

30.title: LATENCIA BACKEND POR ADAPTADOR (promedio ms)

31.title: LLAMADAS AL BACKEND POR TRAMO DE LATENCIA
31.description: Reemplazo del p95: % de llamadas que tardan más de 1 s y de 5 s

32.title: CALIDAD DE DATOS DEL BACKEND ([STREAM])

34.title: RESPUESTAS AL CANAL EN EL TIEMPO (B / M / C)
34.description: C (corregido) va aparte hasta que negocio defina si es éxito o falla

35.title: ERRORES DEL MNGR POR CLUSTER

36.title: RESPUESTAS AL CANAL POR CLUSTER
36.query:
timeseries s = sum(custom.nexus.log.mngr.soap_responses), by: { cluster, acceptance, soap.operation, soap.msg_code }
| filter (in("*", $Cluster) or in(cluster, $Cluster))
| fieldsAdd n = arraySum(s)
| summarize total = sum(n), b = sum(if(acceptance == "B", n, else: 0)),
    m = sum(if(acceptance == "M", n, else: 0)), c = sum(if(acceptance == "C", n, else: 0)),
    by: { cluster }
| fieldsAdd pct_b = round(100.0 * b / total, decimals: 2), pct_m = round(100.0 * m / total, decimals: 2),
            pct_c = round(100.0 * c / total, decimals: 2)
| sort pct_m desc

37.title: OPERACIONES CON MÁS RESPUESTAS M
37.query:
timeseries s = sum(custom.nexus.log.mngr.soap_responses), by: { cluster, acceptance, soap.operation, soap.msg_code }
| filter (in("*", $Cluster) or in(cluster, $Cluster))
| fieldsAdd n = arraySum(s)
| summarize total = sum(n), m = sum(if(acceptance == "M", n, else: 0)),
    by: { cluster, soap.operation, soap.msg_code }
| filter m > 0
| fieldsAdd pct_m = round(100.0 * m / total, decimals: 2)
| sort m desc
| limit 30

38.title: ERRORES DEL MNGR POR SERVICIO Y CANAL
38.query:
timeseries e = sum(custom.nexus.log.mngr.errors), by: { cluster, service, channel }
| filter (in("*", $Cluster) or in(cluster, $Cluster)) and ($Servicio == "*" or service == $Servicio) and (in("*", $Canal) or in(channel, $Canal))
| fieldsAdd errors = arraySum(e)
| fields cluster, service, channel, errors
| filter errors > 0
| sort errors desc
| limit 30

39.title: CONSUMIDOR QUE NO COINCIDE (por 100 tx)
39.query:
timeseries mm = sum(custom.nexus.log.mngr.consumer_mismatch), tx = sum(custom.nexus.log.adapter.responses), by: { cluster }
| filter (in("*", $Cluster) or in(cluster, $Cluster))
| fieldsAdd mismatches = arraySum(mm), transactions = arraySum(tx)
| fieldsAdd per_100_tx = round(100.0 * mismatches / transactions, decimals: 1)
| fields cluster, mismatches, transactions, per_100_tx
| sort per_100_tx desc

40.title: PASOS DEL ESB MÁS LENTOS
40.query:
timeseries avg_ms = avg(custom.nexus.log.esb.step_ms), max_ms = max(custom.nexus.log.esb.step_ms), by: { cluster, service, esb.step }
| filter (in("*", $Cluster) or in(cluster, $Cluster)) and ($Servicio == "*" or service == $Servicio)
| fieldsAdd avg_ms = round(arrayAvg(avg_ms), decimals: 1), max_ms = arrayMax(max_ms)
| fields cluster, service, esb.step, avg_ms, max_ms
| sort avg_ms desc
| limit 30
40.description: avg_ms es el promedio de los promedios por intervalo

42.title: LÍNEAS DE LOG POR NIVEL
42.description: Sin los errores de apagado del adaptador

43.title: WARN Y ERROR POR COMPONENTE
43.query:
timeseries l = sum(custom.nexus.log.log_lines), by: { cluster, component, loglevel }
| filter (in("*", $Cluster) or in(cluster, $Cluster)) and in(loglevel, array("ERROR", "WARN"))
| fieldsAdd lines = arraySum(l)
| fields component, loglevel, lines
| sort lines desc
| limit 30

45.title: ERRORES EN EL TIEMPO POR TIPO
45.query:
fetch logs
| filter dt.system.bucket == "nexus_errores"
| filter (in("*", $Cluster) or in(nexus.cluster, $Cluster)) and ($Servicio == "*" or nexus.service == $Servicio) and (in("*", $Canal) or in(nexus.channel, $Canal))
| makeTimeseries errors = count(), by: { nexus.kind }

46.title: ERRORES POR CLUSTER, SERVICIO, CANAL Y TIPO
46.query:
fetch logs
| filter dt.system.bucket == "nexus_errores"
| filter (in("*", $Cluster) or in(nexus.cluster, $Cluster)) and ($Servicio == "*" or nexus.service == $Servicio) and (in("*", $Canal) or in(nexus.channel, $Canal))
| summarize errors = count(), by: { nexus.cluster, nexus.service, nexus.channel, nexus.kind }
| sort errors desc
| limit 50

47.title: ERRORES DE MAPEO CON EJEMPLO
47.query:
// the example is built at query time; 1= values may be customer data, so digits become 9
fetch logs
| filter dt.system.bucket == "nexus_errores"
| filter (in("*", $Cluster) or in(nexus.cluster, $Cluster)) and ($Servicio == "*" or nexus.service == $Servicio) and (in("*", $Canal) or in(nexus.channel, $Canal))
| filter nexus.kind == "mapping_error"
| parse content, "LD '. 1=' LD:params SPACE? '::HEAD::'"
| fieldsAdd args = splitString(params, ", ")
| fieldsAdd p1_shape = substring(replacePattern(args[0], "DIGIT", "9"), from: 0, to: 20),
            p2 = substring(args[1], from: 2), p3 = substring(args[2], from: 2)
| fieldsAdd example = replaceString(replaceString(replaceString(nexus.mapping.rule, "%1", coalesce(p1_shape, "%1")),
                      "%2", coalesce(p2, "%2")), "%3", coalesce(p3, "%3"))
| summarize total = count(), example = takeFirst(example), rquid = takeFirst(nexus.rquid),
    by: { nexus.cluster, nexus.service, nexus.channel, nexus.mapping.direction, nexus.mapping.field, nexus.mapping.rule }
| sort total desc
| limit 50

48.title: RQUIDS CON ERROR (respuesta del adaptador)
48.query:
fetch logs
| filter dt.system.bucket == "nexus_errores"
| filter (in("*", $Cluster) or in(nexus.cluster, $Cluster)) and ($Servicio == "*" or nexus.service == $Servicio) and (in("*", $Canal) or in(nexus.channel, $Canal))
| filter nexus.kind == "audit_resp" and nexus.outcome == "error"
| parse content, "LD '\"system\":\"' LD:error_system '\"'"
| parse content, "LD '\"message\":\"' LD:error_message '\"'"
| fields timestamp, nexus.cluster, nexus.service, nexus.channel, nexus.rquid, nexus.http_code, error_system, error_message
| sort timestamp desc
| limit 200

49.title: TIMEOUTS 504 Y RESPUESTAS TARDÍAS DE STRATUS
49.query:
fetch logs
| filter dt.system.bucket == "nexus_errores"
| filter (in("*", $Cluster) or in(nexus.cluster, $Cluster)) and ($Servicio == "*" or nexus.service == $Servicio) and (in("*", $Canal) or in(nexus.channel, $Canal))
| filter in(nexus.kind, array("timeout_504", "stratus_late_reply"))
| fields timestamp, nexus.kind, nexus.component, nexus.service, nexus.channel, nexus.rquid
| sort timestamp desc
| limit 200

50.title: ERRORES DEL MNGR POR MENSAJE
50.query:
// digits become 9 so the variants of the same message group together
fetch logs
| filter dt.system.bucket == "nexus_errores" and nexus.kind == "mngr_error"
| filter (in("*", $Cluster) or in(nexus.cluster, $Cluster)) and ($Servicio == "*" or nexus.service == $Servicio) and (in("*", $Canal) or in(nexus.channel, $Canal))
| parse content, "LD '[ERROR' LD ']' SPACE? LD:message"
| fieldsAdd pattern = substring(replacePattern(message, "DIGIT", "9"), from: 0, to: 120)
| summarize errors = count(), rquid = takeFirst(nexus.rquid),
    by: { nexus.cluster, nexus.service, nexus.channel, pattern }
| sort errors desc
| limit 50

51.title: RECHAZOS AL CANAL (M)
51.query:
fetch logs
| filter dt.system.bucket == "nexus_errores" and nexus.acceptance == "M"
| filter (in("*", $Cluster) or in(nexus.cluster, $Cluster))
| summarize rejections = count(), rquid = takeFirst(nexus.rquid),
    by: { nexus.cluster, nexus.soap.operation, nexus.soap.msg_code }
| sort rejections desc
| limit 50
51.description: El canal no viaja en la respuesta SOAP

52.content: ### 6. Transacciones y traza por rquid (Rquid ignora los filtros)

53.title: VISTA POR TRANSACCIÓN
53.query:
// one row per rquid: what the channel got, how long the ESB and the backend took
fetch logs
| filter in(dt.system.bucket, array("logs_integracion", "nexus_errores"))
| filter isNotNull(nexus.rquid) and (in("*", $Cluster) or in(nexus.cluster, $Cluster)) and ($Servicio == "*" or nexus.service == $Servicio)
| summarize channel = takeAny(nexus.channel),
            http_code = max(if(nexus.kind == "audit_resp", nexus.http_code)),
            esb_ms = sum(if(nexus.kind == "esb_step", nexus.duration_ms)),
            backend_ms = max(if(nexus.kind == "backend_time", nexus.duration_ms)),
            by: { nexus.cluster, nexus.service, nexus.rquid }
| filter in("*", $Canal) or in(channel, $Canal)
| sort esb_ms desc
| limit 200
53.description: Elegir un servicio y un rango corto

54.title: TRAZA RQUID
54.query:
fetch logs
| filter in(dt.system.bucket, array("logs_integracion", "nexus_errores"))
| filter nexus.rquid == $Rquid or contains(content, $Rquid)
| fields timestamp, nexus.component, nexus.kind, nexus.duration_ms, content
| sort timestamp asc
| limit 1000

55.content: ### 7. Salud del pipeline (últimos 15 minutos, ignora los filtros)

56.title: LOG GROUPS ENRUTADOS Y PROCESADOS
56.description: routed = cumple la condición de la ruta; processed = la ingesta agregó nexus.cluster

57.title: MÉTRICAS CON DATOS EN EL RANGO
57.query:
// one row per metric; total 0 = no data in the timeframe
data record(metric = "adapter.responses", total = 0.0),
     record(metric = "adapter.mapping_errors", total = 0.0),
     record(metric = "adapter.timeouts", total = 0.0),
     record(metric = "adapter.backend_ms", total = 0.0),
     record(metric = "adapter.backend_calls", total = 0.0),
     record(metric = "mngr.errors", total = 0.0),
     record(metric = "mngr.soap_responses", total = 0.0),
     record(metric = "mngr.consumer_mismatch", total = 0.0),
     record(metric = "adapter.stratus_late_replies", total = 0.0),
     record(metric = "adapter.stream_issues", total = 0.0),
     record(metric = "log_lines", total = 0.0),
     record(metric = "esb.step_ms", total = 0.0)
| append [timeseries v = sum(custom.nexus.log.adapter.responses) | fields metric = "adapter.responses", total = toDouble(arraySum(v))]
| append [timeseries v = sum(custom.nexus.log.adapter.mapping_errors) | fields metric = "adapter.mapping_errors", total = toDouble(arraySum(v))]
| append [timeseries v = sum(custom.nexus.log.adapter.timeouts) | fields metric = "adapter.timeouts", total = toDouble(arraySum(v))]
| append [timeseries v = sum(custom.nexus.log.adapter.backend_ms) | fields metric = "adapter.backend_ms", total = toDouble(arraySum(v))]
| append [timeseries v = sum(custom.nexus.log.adapter.backend_calls) | fields metric = "adapter.backend_calls", total = toDouble(arraySum(v))]
| append [timeseries v = sum(custom.nexus.log.mngr.errors) | fields metric = "mngr.errors", total = toDouble(arraySum(v))]
| append [timeseries v = sum(custom.nexus.log.mngr.soap_responses) | fields metric = "mngr.soap_responses", total = toDouble(arraySum(v))]
| append [timeseries v = sum(custom.nexus.log.mngr.consumer_mismatch) | fields metric = "mngr.consumer_mismatch", total = toDouble(arraySum(v))]
| append [timeseries v = sum(custom.nexus.log.adapter.stratus_late_replies) | fields metric = "adapter.stratus_late_replies", total = toDouble(arraySum(v))]
| append [timeseries v = sum(custom.nexus.log.adapter.stream_issues) | fields metric = "adapter.stream_issues", total = toDouble(arraySum(v))]
| append [timeseries v = sum(custom.nexus.log.log_lines) | fields metric = "log_lines", total = toDouble(arraySum(v))]
| append [timeseries v = sum(custom.nexus.log.esb.step_ms) | fields metric = "esb.step_ms", total = toDouble(arraySum(v))]
| summarize total = max(total), by: { metric }
| sort total asc
57.description: Usa el rango del tablero. total 0 = la métrica no tiene datos

58.title: LÍNEAS POR BUCKET
58.description: Esperado: nexus_errores solo con true y logs_integracion solo con false

59.title: ERRORES DEL MNGR: LOGS VS ATRIBUTO
59.query:
// truth = the old alert's definition: case-sensitive "[ERROR" in a ws mngr line
fetch logs, from: now()-15m
| filter in(dt.system.bucket, array("logs_integracion", "nexus_errores"))
| filter startsWith(aws.log_group, "/aws/ecs/srv/") and endsWith(aws.log_group, "-mngr")
| parse aws.log_group, "'/aws/ecs/srv/' LD:cluster 'ws-'"
| fieldsAdd truth = contains(content, "[ERROR"), tagged = coalesce(nexus.kind, "") == "mngr_error"
| summarize truth = countIf(truth), tagged = countIf(tagged),
    missed = countIf(truth and not tagged), extra = countIf(tagged and not truth),
    in_errors_bucket = countIf(truth and dt.system.bucket == "nexus_errores"), by: { cluster }
| sort truth desc
